2609.40070.title: Inference Auctions
2609.40070.paper_summary: When inference demand exceeds available compute capacity, model providers must decide which requests should be served first. Users have different tolerances for delay from an LLM API, but current priority pricing schemes compress these differences into coarse fixed-price service tiers. We design an inference auction that allows users to bid for faster service. Our auction allocates priority in an economically efficient way without sacrificing latency, and we develop fast algorithms for implementing prices that incentivize truthful bidding. We also design an autobidding agent for our inference auction, where users specify an inference budget and the autobidder dynamically adjusts its bids over time to maximize user utility subject to the budget constraint. Experiments validate the practicality of our auction: it increases system welfare while maintaining the cache utilization and latency advantages of SGLang, a state-of-the-art inference serving framework.
2609.40070.paper_summary_zh: 當推斷需求超過可用的計算能力時，模型提供者必須決定哪些請求應該優先處理。用戶對於 LLM API 的延遲容忍度各不相同，但目前的優先定價方案將這些差異壓縮成粗略的固定價格服務層級。我們設計了一個推斷拍賣，允許用戶出價以獲得更快的服務。我們的拍賣以經濟高效的方式分配優先權，而不犧牲延遲，我們還開發了快速算法來實施激勵誠實出價的價格。我們還為我們的推斷拍賣設計了一個自動出價代理，用戶可以指定推斷預算，自動出價者會隨著時間的推移動態調整其出價，以最大化用戶在預算約束下的效用。實驗驗證了我們拍賣的實用性：它在保持 SGLang 的快取利用率和延遲優勢的同時，提高了系統福利，SGLang 是一個最先進的推斷服務框架。
